Aim the phone and tap to select
Swipe across the center to change pages
Swipe inward from a side marker to go back
Swipe up from the bottom marker to go home, or hold for one second to recenter

CF20 connected
Aim and press Confirm to select
Swipe the touchpad to change pages
Press Home to go home, or hold for one second to recenter
